fixed_protocol.note: Cases selected by independent reviewer from frequency diagnostics before any new rollout outcomes. Separate family from original seven cases.

interpretation_scope: Saved strategy plus complete pinned legacy computed-defence runtime, including inherited deep-raise reference fallbacks; exact support/board/hand/observed bet, not GTO or population EV.
family_error_scope: Nominal 0.01 for these eight fixed cases under IID Monte Carlo approximation; combining original seven and these eight spends nominal union bound 0.02, not 0.01. Deterministic seeded PRNG is not a formal random-bits guarantee.
limits: Original raw report limits are retained verbatim in raw_report and superseded where needed by interpretation_scope.
Positive or negative call versus fold is conditional on the pinned future policy. It does not rank raises or prove optimal strategy.
No evidence certificates or policy frequencies were changed or approved by completion of these runs.
Normal intervals remain descriptive; classification uses the predeclared empirical-Bernstein interval only.

empirical_bernstein.independence_assumption: Nominal statistical coverage under IID Monte Carlo draws; deterministic seeded PRNG approximation is not a formal random-source guarantee.

limits: Continuation uses the existing saved strategy and current computed defence, not optimized play.
Hero exact combo is fixed; opponent range is saved own-action reach conditioned on the observed bet and card removal.
No equilibrium or external-population validity claim.
Legacy same-amount all-in action labels condition different ranges; that known model limitation is preserved.
An initial floor-only ablation cannot change forced-call continuation because calling completes the flop.
The normal interval is descriptive; the conservative empirical-Bernstein interval is the bounded fixed-sample diagnostic.
